names.legendary: Cryonarch, Tyrant of August

lore.common: Hums a lullaby through its vents. Nobody sleeps because it only knows the first three notes.
lore.uncommon: Blows freezing air directly at the one person who said they were comfortable. It considers this customer service.
lore.rare: Breathes frost onto anyone who calls the room "a bit warm". They leave with icicles for eyebrows.
lore.epic: Swallowed a heatwave and spat out a blizzard that turned the town fountain into a spiral staircase of ice.
lore.legendary: When Cryonarch awakens, summer kneels before its cold breath. Ice cream sellers have worshipped this air conditioner for centuries.

names.legendary: Effervessa, Queen of the Violet Tide

lore.common: Fizzes furiously for eight seconds, then demands a standing ovation from the rubber duck.
lore.uncommon: Leaves glitter on every towel, elbow and unsuspecting houseguest for the next three winters.
lore.rare: Transforms the dog's water bowl into a lavender spa. The dog has started charging admission.
lore.epic: Turned a bathtub into a purple geyser and launched the bathrobe into the neighbour's apple tree.
lore.legendary: Once dissolved into the great ocean and perfumed every wave for a century. Mermaids still argue about whether lavender was a mistake.

names.legendary: Commodore Bathsworth, Admiral of Foam

lore.common: Takes forty minutes to fill and four seconds to go cold. The rubber duck calls this sabotage.
lore.uncommon: Makes suspicious sounds through the plughole whenever guests arrive. Denies having a sense of humour.
lore.rare: Swallows every bubble before the bather is ready. Its appetite is apparently bottomless.
lore.epic: Overflowed through the ceiling and turned the kitchen into a waterfall. Dad took his shampoo downstairs to save time.
lore.legendary: Sailed down the high street with a full naval escort of rubber ducks. The admiral saluted every traffic light and refused to dock until teatime.

names.legendary: Vortemix, Devourer of Ingredients

lore.common: Roars like a jet taking off and produces one disappointing spoonful of smoothie.
lore.uncommon: Walks across the counter whenever switched on. Always towards the edge, never away.
lore.rare: Swallows any object within arm's reach and turns it into an astonishingly green drink. Nobody mentions Grandad's glasses.
lore.epic: Blew its lid and painted the kitchen ceiling in strawberry pink. Estate agents now describe the room as a modern art installation.
lore.legendary: In its spinning glass belly, whole seasons become soups. It once blended a thundercloud into lemonade, and every sip still rumbles.

names.legendary: Nibula, the Unwritten Queen

lore.common: Sneaks into the pocket of a white shirt and leaves a blue autograph nobody remembers requesting.
lore.uncommon: Leaves an elegant blue signature on every white shirt. Refuses to admit it was a leak.
lore.rare: Can rewrite a sentence while the author sleeps. Usually changes every character's name to Gary.
lore.epic: Spilled into the royal library and made every book write its own sequel. The librarians haven't slept since.
lore.legendary: Nibula's midnight ink writes the names of people not yet born. Every blank page is a prophecy; every crossed-out word becomes a ghost of a forgotten story.

names.legendary: Lady Aquafinch, Keeper of Skywater

lore.common: Has one very strict bathing rule: the grumpiest pigeon gets the whole tub.
lore.uncommon: Refills itself from passing clouds. The sparrows have started calling it room service.
lore.rare: Blesses every bathing crow with an opera voice. The neighbours miss ordinary cawing.
lore.epic: Turned the garden into a miniature waterpark, complete with duck lifeguards and one seagull demanding a refund.
lore.legendary: In its marble basin, migrating flocks see the rivers they must follow. The maps are perfect, though the water tastes faintly of pigeons.

names.legendary: Bailmor, Guardian of the Stolen Sea

lore.common: Clanks its handle against its side like a tiny village bell.
lore.uncommon: Leaks one cold drop directly into every dry shoe carried past it.
lore.rare: Always has one last splash left, even after being turned upside down. It saves it for clean socks.
lore.epic: Scooped so much sand in one go that a new castle appeared on the beach. The local builders complained about unfair competition.
lore.legendary: Bailmor once carried the sea away for an afternoon so the stranded sailors could walk home. He returned every wave before sunset except the one he kept as a pet.

names.legendary: Welloria, the Door to the Deep

lore.common: Repeats whatever you shout down it, but adds a cheeky little laugh.
lore.uncommon: Counts every coin dropped inside and refuses to reveal the total.
lore.rare: Answers questions from the dark with riddles that are irritatingly accurate.
lore.epic: Hiccuped a century of forgotten wishes back into the village square. Three hundred people received their childhood ponies all at once.
lore.legendary: Holds an underground pool that remembers the names of everyone who has ever visited. A single whispered wish can summon a lost voice to its rim for one precious answer.

names.legendary: Barrelora, Thief of Borrowed Storms

lore.common: Waits beneath the drainpipe with its mouth open, then complains when it rains.
lore.uncommon: Collects rainwater and inadvertently opens the village's busiest mosquito hotel.
lore.rare: Sends tiny rain clouds to follow whoever forgets to water the flowers.
lore.epic: Swallowed an entire downpour and overflowed into the street as a gleaming river. The garden gnomes declared independence and sailed downstream.
lore.legendary: Barrelora caught seven storms inside a single wooden belly. When the village complained of drought, she sneezed and filled the entire duck pond.

names.legendary: Souptronaut, Keeper of the Moon Broth

lore.common: Hides its ring pull until everyone has already dirtied the tin opener.
lore.uncommon: Rattles when shaken even though the label clearly says 'smooth'.
lore.rare: Heats itself on cold days and whispers the recipe of whichever grandmother you miss.
lore.epic: Sprang its lid in the supermarket and filled three aisles with a fragrant tide of tomato soup. The bread department cheered.
lore.legendary: Souptronaut carried the first warm meal to the dark side of the Moon. One drop still floats above the crater, attracting homesick astronauts.

names.legendary: Aquavault, the Reservoir Above

lore.common: Gurgles in the attic whenever someone washes their hands.
lore.uncommon: Makes ghostly groaning noises at three in the morning, purely for entertainment.
lore.rare: Sends water upward through the pipes so the shower occasionally rains from the floor.
lore.epic: Burst into a waterfall down the staircase during a winter freeze. By breakfast the family had invented indoor sledging.
lore.legendary: Held a vast lake above a city built on dry stone. Each night it released just enough water for the sleeping gardens, and the city's children grew up believing rain came from the rooftops.

names.legendary: Baristella, Bringer of the First Dawn

lore.common: Dribbles hot coffee down the chin through its supposedly spill-proof lid.
lore.uncommon: Cools down only when someone says they have plenty of time to drink it.
lore.rare: Rewrites every name on its cardboard sleeve. The entire office has been calling Dave 'Turnip' since Tuesday.
lore.epic: Gave an exhausted city such a burst of coffee-powered energy that everyone finished Friday's work before Wednesday's lunch break.
lore.legendary: Baristella brewed the first cup at the edge of a sleepless dawn, and the smell guided wandering stars back to their places before sunrise.

names.legendary: Espressimo, Lord of the Stolen Hours

lore.common: Makes thirty seconds of dramatic noises before providing twelve drops of coffee.
lore.uncommon: Hisses the names of whoever stole the office biscuits through its steam wand.
lore.rare: Can make espresso so concentrated that the cup stays awake after everybody leaves.
lore.epic: Broke down during the royal budget meeting. The kingdom experienced six hours of unprecedented silence followed by a ministerial rebellion.
lore.legendary: Espressimo brewed the cup that taught the sun to rise early. Every dawn he demands one perfect shot in tribute, and every barista in the realm fears the words DESCALING REQUIRED.

names.legendary: Creasebridge, Weaver of Smooth Roads

lore.common: Unfolds with a clatter loud enough to convince the neighbours you're moving house.
lore.uncommon: Folds one leg the moment someone lays out a freshly washed shirt.
lore.rare: Raises itself another notch every time the ironer looks away. Eventually even the ceiling gets pressed.
lore.epic: Snapped open at the top of the stairs and carried the entire family down to breakfast like a padded sled. The bannister wants a rematch.
lore.legendary: Creasebridge unfolded across a valley when the ancient stone bridge collapsed. Travellers crossed its padded back for a century without wrinkling a single shirt.

names.legendary: Cyclorath, Judge of the Last Dish

lore.common: Always puts one fork back in the drawer still wearing yesterday's sauce.
lore.uncommon: Steals teaspoons to furnish its secret underwater apartment.
lore.rare: Decides which plates deserve to be clean. The lasagna dish has been on probation for months.
lore.epic: Opened its door and unleashed a steam tribunal where every dirty plate testified against its owner. The frying pan pleaded the fifth.
lore.legendary: The ancient kitchens entrusted Cyclorath with the impossible task of washing a feast for ten thousand kings. It finished before dessert and invoiced them for rinse aid.

names.legendary: Zephyrax, Lord of the Borrowed Wind

lore.common: Oscillates politely until someone needs a breeze, then faces the wall.
lore.uncommon: Eats loose papers and spits them across the room in alphabetic order.
lore.rare: Can turn one whispered secret into a booming robot voice. The office meetings are now outdoor events.
lore.epic: Spun so furiously during a heatwave that the town's weather vane took flight. It landed on the mayor's birthday cake.
lore.legendary: Zephyrax caught the last breeze of a windless summer inside its silver blades. When freed, the air carried sailors safely home and stole every hat on the harbor.

names.legendary: Hydros, Tamer of the Crimson River

lore.common: Has become the neighbourhood dogs' most popular meeting place.
lore.uncommon: Looks like a tiny red knight guarding a pavement no one wants to invade.
lore.rare: Can turn the street into a water park with one determined cough.
lore.epic: Sent a fountain of water over the town square during a heatwave. The ice-cream van floated past the library and reported record sales.
lore.legendary: Hydros held back a wildfire with a river drawn from beneath the oldest streets. The children named it king of summer and made a tiny crown for its cap.

names.legendary: Fluteria, Voice of the Thousand Toasts

lore.common: Wobbles on a stem too thin for its enormous opinion of itself.
lore.uncommon: Waits until a wedding speech begins before tipping into someone's lap.
lore.rare: Makes the person holding it float three inches above the floor whenever bubbles rise.
lore.epic: Clinked one note at a royal wedding and shattered every awkward silence in the room. The best man had to give an actual speech.
lore.legendary: Fluteria has chimed at every coronation since glasses were invented. One perfect note can turn a quarrel into a celebration, or an anniversary into a proposal.

names.legendary: Shakazar, Alchemist of the Final Sip

lore.common: Rattles like a tiny thunderstorm whenever someone wants a peaceful evening.
lore.uncommon: Keeps one ice cube trapped in its lid forever. Names it Kevin.
lore.rare: Can turn plain water into a mystery drink that tastes suspiciously like Tuesday.
lore.epic: Shook a hundred ingredients so fiercely that the royal orchestra began playing in its rhythm. The punch bowl applied to become a drummer.
lore.legendary: Shakazar once mixed starlight, sea foam and a single stolen cherry into the first perfect drink. The recipe remains secret because he forgot which lid he used.

names.legendary: Vitralis, Vessel of the First Rain

lore.common: Hides one fingerprint on the exact spot everyone notices.
lore.uncommon: Sticks to the coaster, then drops it just as somebody makes a toast.
lore.rare: Can repeat every secret spoken across its rim. The family dinners have become much quieter.
lore.epic: Sang one note so pure that every drinking glass in the banquet hall answered. The chandeliers demanded an encore.
lore.legendary: Vitralis caught the first rain to fall upon the ancient kingdom. Whoever drinks from it sees the sky as it looked before the first cloud was born.

names.legendary: Gyrogold, Keeper of the Golden Turn

lore.common: Watches its chicken go round until it gets dizzy, then blames the cook.
lore.uncommon: Spins its dinner exactly once whenever somebody says they are starving.
lore.rare: Turns every item placed near it, including the cook's hat and the restaurant sign, into a slow moving parade.
lore.epic: Spun a hundred roast chickens at the summer fair until the aroma summoned half the county. The vegetarian stall demanded its own wind direction.
lore.legendary: Gyrogold turns the sun upon an invisible roasting spit every evening. When the stars smell of garlic and rosemary, the astronomers know he is preparing a feast.

names.legendary: Ferrosmooth, the Iron of Perfect Lines

lore.common: Hisses at every shirt as though personally offended by its wrinkles.
lore.uncommon: Creates a shiny mark on the most expensive trousers in the wardrobe. No refunds.
lore.rare: Presses such sharp creases that envelopes try to use them as letter openers.
lore.epic: Flattened the royal banquet cloth so perfectly that the palace floor, walls and staircases followed. Guests spent the evening sliding into dinner.
lore.legendary: Ferrosmooth once pressed a crooked road straight across a continent. The mountains still resent losing their bends, and the local speed bumps are organising a rebellion.

names.legendary: Railmara, the Rungs to Elsewhere

lore.common: Waits until the floor is dry before dropping a soaking towel.
lore.uncommon: Steals the biggest bath towel and leaves a face cloth for Dad.
lore.rare: Grows an extra hook whenever someone brings a guest, then hangs the guest's coat in the bathroom.
lore.epic: Shot six warm towels into the air at once and wrapped the entire family like surprised pastry rolls.
lore.legendary: Railmara was forged by a bathhouse spirit from the last ladder leading out of the underworld. Each polished rail offers a different door, but only if you bring your own towel.

names.legendary: Mugnarok, Chalice of the Endless Refill

lore.common: Keeps one brown tea ring no amount of washing can remove. Calls it character.
lore.uncommon: Is chipped on the handle and somehow remains everybody's favourite.
lore.rare: Can keep a drink hot for its chosen owner and make it ice-cold for anyone else. Workplace politics have become intense.
lore.epic: Was left in the office sink so long that a thriving goldfish civilisation formed inside. They now demand a separate dishwasher.
lore.legendary: Mugnarok was forged around the first morning brew and never runs empty for a worthy traveller. Unworthy hands receive lukewarm decaf and an unhelpful inspirational quote.

names.legendary: Longnood, Serpent of a Thousand Bowls

lore.common: Slaps a tiny line of broth onto every clean shirt at lunchtime.
lore.uncommon: Twists into a knot around the chopsticks and refuses to unravel without applause.
lore.rare: Reaches across the table to tie diners' shoelaces together with one slippery strand.
lore.epic: Rose from the soup as an enormous noodle dragon and lifted every bowl into the air. The kitchen staff rode its back with ladles raised.
lore.legendary: Longnood stretched one golden strand from the first kitchen to the last feast of an ancient empire. Each bowl it touched brought warm food to travellers who had none.

names.legendary: Bakesworth, Keeper of the Eternal Loaf

lore.common: Warms the baking tray until you can smell the cake, then claims the middle needs another hour.
lore.uncommon: Browns the back of every biscuit first and refuses to explain its favourites.
lore.rare: Twists its own temperature dial when the cook turns away. The roast now requires a written contract.
lore.epic: Baked a sponge so enormous it lifted the kitchen ceiling and turned the upstairs bath into a custard pool. The plumber requested a slice.
lore.legendary: Bakesworth sheltered a starving village inside a single golden loaf through the longest winter. Each dawn the crust grew back, and the village never again ran short of breakfast.

names.legendary: Lemonella, Keeper of the Impossible Pour

lore.common: Spills a little lemonade down its own side every single time it serves a glass.
lore.uncommon: Refuses to pour until someone puts one more lemon slice inside.
lore.rare: Fills every cup with what its owner secretly wants to drink. Grandad keeps getting milkshakes.
lore.epic: Turned the village picnic into a lemonade river when it refused to stop pouring. The ants built tiny rafts out of crackers.
lore.legendary: Lemonella poured water across a drought-stricken valley without spilling a single drop on the dry roads. Every empty well filled, and the river sang through the night.

names.legendary: Saponella, Keeper of the Last Bubble

lore.common: Hatches a puddle of soap slime overnight and blames the toothbrush.
lore.uncommon: Lets the soap escape every time an important guest comes to wash their hands.
lore.rare: Commands all the soap bars in the house to slide across the tiles and form a very slippery barricade.
lore.epic: Flooded the royal bathhouse with a tide of bubbles high enough to float the marble statues down the corridor.
lore.legendary: Saponella guarded one perfect soap bubble through a thousand baths. Inside it was the reflection of a bathroom that had never once needed cleaning.

names.legendary: Radiathor, Hearth of the Winterbound

lore.common: Gurgles in the wall whenever everyone else is trying to sleep.
lore.uncommon: Claims the warmest spot in the room, which is exactly where the cat already sits.
lore.rare: Shrinks damp socks left on its ribs until the children can wear them as gloves.
lore.epic: Heated an abandoned manor so fiercely that tropical vines sprouted through every window. The ghosts opened a juice bar.
lore.legendary: Radiathor heated an abandoned castle through a century of winter. Its ghostly residents finally complained that their hot chocolate kept evaporating.

names.legendary: Squeakzilla, Terror of the Tiny Tub

lore.common: Stores cold bathwater in its beak for the exact moment a parent sits beside the tub.
lore.uncommon: Floats away every time somebody reaches for it, then returns when the taps are off.
lore.rare: Leads a squadron of bath toys into battle against the shampoo bottle. Nobody can explain the foam casualties.
lore.epic: Organised a naval battle in the family bathtub so fierce that the towels declared themselves lifeboats. The bathroom mat was promoted to admiral.
lore.legendary: Squeakzilla's first squeak raised a tidal wave from a porcelain bath. The wave returned all the lost toys from a hundred drains and one very annoyed plumber.

names.legendary: Sinkthulhu, Beneath the Plughole

lore.common: Drips once every ten seconds until someone comes to investigate. Then it goes quiet.
lore.uncommon: Hides a teaspoon in its plumbing and gurgles whenever anybody asks where it went.
lore.rare: Can swallow a whole day's dirty dishes and return them spotless, but keeps every missing teaspoon as payment.
lore.epic: Overflowed with soap bubbles until the kitchen became an ocean. The dishcloths built rafts and declared themselves independent.
lore.legendary: Sinkthulhu waits in the dark pipes below a thousand kitchens, surrounded by lost wedding rings and teaspoons. Summon him with a dripping tap and he may return one treasure, or ask for more washing up.

names.legendary: Brewmara, the Thunder's Teapot

lore.common: Dribbles a little tea on the table and looks innocent beneath its lid.
lore.uncommon: Rattles its lid when the kettle whistles as though they are old friends.
lore.rare: Refuses to pour for anyone who forgets please and thank you, then pours double for their grandmother.
lore.epic: Brewed a pot so strong that the biscuits marched out of the tin and demanded their own afternoon break.
lore.legendary: Brewmara calmed the thunder god with one endless pot of tea. Every storm since has paused for a quiet sip before beginning its rain.

names.legendary: Automunch, Inventor of Impossible Snacks

lore.common: Swallows a coin and pretends it has never heard of money.
lore.uncommon: Rejects the same banknote five times, then takes it triumphantly.
lore.rare: Dispenses the snack it thinks you need, which is always suspiciously raisin-shaped.
lore.epic: Dropped every snack in the school at once. For three glorious days the corridors ran on a strict economy of crisps.
lore.legendary: Built a vending machine inside its own vending machine, selling flavours not yet invented. The first customer bought a packet of Tuesday and demanded a refund.

names.legendary: Waffelgor, Smith of the Golden Grid

lore.common: Bites down on batter and hiccups a square of steam.
lore.uncommon: Squeezes excess batter out like toothpaste whenever it gets excited.
lore.rare: Prints perfect waffle patterns onto everything, including the neighbour's newspaper.
lore.epic: Forged a waffle large enough to become the town's dance floor. The syrup was excellent, but the tango lessons were a disaster.
lore.legendary: Pressed the first sunrise into a golden lattice of warmth. Every winter morning its ancient plates remember that heat, even before anyone turns the power on.

names.legendary: Bubblor, the Whispering Reservoir

lore.common: Gulps loudly whenever anyone fills a paper cup.
lore.uncommon: Attracts colleagues who were supposedly just passing by.
lore.rare: Burps out office secrets in the exact voice of whoever told them.
lore.epic: Launched a giant bubble into the ceiling during a company meeting. It carried the boss's important presentation all the way to the car park.
lore.legendary: Listened to every secret shared beside its blue bottle for thirty years. On its retirement day it answered each one with precisely the advice nobody had dared give.

names.legendary: Verdandra, the Cloud in a Can

lore.common: Pours water mostly onto its own toes.
lore.uncommon: Sprinkles the garden in neat rows, then accidentally waters the gnome.
lore.rare: Makes seedlings grow so quickly that the gardener has to mow the flowerbeds.
lore.epic: Watered the scarecrow instead of the roses. By sundown it had grown into a leafy giant and was demanding its own allotment.
lore.legendary: Carried a piece of the first raincloud inside its tin belly. Wherever the soil had forgotten how to bloom, it could still teach a single seed to wake.

names.legendary: Aeralith, Judge of the First Breath

lore.common: Gobbles dust from the air and displays its collection proudly on the filter. Nobody is impressed.
lore.uncommon: Its warning light turns red whenever someone burns toast. It has an extremely dramatic personality.
lore.rare: Steals every scent in the room, including dinner. Its favourite prank is making onions smell like absolutely nothing.
lore.epic: Inhaled a factory's smog and exhaled a rainstorm of clean air. Then it presented the mayor with a filter-replacement bill.
lore.legendary: Aeralith filtered a volcano's first breath through a single paper cartridge. For a thousand years the mountains smelled of peppermint.

names.legendary: Sir Scaldalot, Warden of the Two Taps

lore.common: Drips exactly once per minute, but only when somebody is trying to sleep.
lore.uncommon: Squeaks whenever turned. The cat thinks there is a mouse trapped in the plumbing.
lore.rare: Switches from glacier water to volcano water in a heartbeat. The shampoo bottles take cover.
lore.epic: Turned one handle and summoned a whirlpool into the bathroom. The rubber duck is now captain of a bathtub fleet.
lore.legendary: Guards the fabled Perfect Temperature, a treasure sought for centuries. No mortal has turned the handles correctly twice in a row.

names.legendary: Haricotus, Emperor of the Endless Tin

lore.common: Escapes the spoon and rolls beneath the toast. Refuses to come out until the meal is over.
lore.uncommon: Lives in orange sauce and insists it is a luxurious tomato spa.
lore.rare: Makes every diner hum the same tune after lunch. Nobody wants to explain how the melody is produced.
lore.epic: Escaped the tin in one enormous cylinder and rolled through the town square. The mayor appointed it a temporary traffic barrier.
lore.legendary: Fed a hundred hungry giants from one tin. Their grateful trumpeting still echoes through the mountains every Tuesday.

names.legendary: Baron Humpen, Herald of the Toast

lore.common: Flips its little lid whenever anyone says cheers, even if the mug is empty.
lore.uncommon: Closes its pewter lid on the owner's nose at least once per festival. Calls it a traditional greeting.
lore.rare: Can summon a booming drinking song merely by touching a tavern table. The choir is never in tune.
lore.epic: Clanged at the beer festival so loudly that the mountains echoed PROST for an entire week.
lore.legendary: The old stein never empties while friends remain around the table. Its engraved dragons come alive at midnight to demand another chorus.

names.legendary: Madame Bidella, Oracle of the Rear

lore.common: Confuses every visitor to the holiday apartment. Has heard some remarkable theories.
lore.uncommon: Is mistaken for a foot bath by children and a drinking fountain by one very bold cat.
lore.rare: Answers the question WHAT IS THAT FOR differently every time. No two guests have ever agreed.
lore.epic: Launched a fountain so powerful that every bar of soap in the bathroom landed neatly on the balcony next door.
lore.legendary: Wields a jet so precise it can polish a royal throne from across the palace. Her greatest secret is how she makes everyone leave feeling important.

names.legendary: Porcelina, Last Empress of the Thin Rim

lore.common: Is so delicate you can read the newspaper through its wall. Its owner reads slowly.
lore.uncommon: Has a handle for one finger and an attitude for twelve.
lore.rare: Makes every drinker raise their pinkie. Even the pirates obey, and they're furious about it.
lore.epic: Hosted a garden tea party so formal the roses stood at attention and the teaspoons began saluting the sugar bowl.
lore.legendary: One sip from Porcelina brought a hundred warring kings to peaceful tea. They still argue over whose biscuit was dipped first.

names.legendary: Don Burritron, Lord of the Endless Bowl

lore.common: Lives beneath the rice and steals exactly one bean from every spoonful.
lore.uncommon: Sneezes salsa across the table whenever anyone calls it mild.
lore.rare: Rearranges its rice, beans and guacamole into a new face after each bite. The face is getting angrier.
lore.epic: Turned an entire food court into a mariachi battlefield. The sour cream barricades held for three glorious hours.
lore.legendary: His porcelain kingdom contains seven rice provinces, an avocado navy and a bean uprising. He rules with an iron tortilla and terrible table manners.

names.legendary: Enamelda, Chalice of the Wandering Star

lore.common: Clatters against everything in your rucksack, including things in somebody else's rucksack.
lore.uncommon: Keeps your tea scalding hot until you stop wanting it, then turns it cold instantly.
lore.rare: Can summon a squirrel with one tap of its enamel rim. It has accidentally summoned an entire forest.
lore.epic: Bounced from a mountain summit into a campsite without spilling a drop. The climbers took three days to follow it down.
lore.legendary: Enamelda once held the last warm drink before the great winter swallowed the world. Whoever sips from her rim can hear the campfires of every traveller who came before.

names.legendary: Crunchmor, Devourer of the First Morning

lore.common: Sounds like gravel being poured into a bowl. Somehow this is breakfast.
lore.uncommon: Becomes soggy before the spoon reaches it, then complains about the milk.
lore.rare: Summons hungry family members with a single box rattle. They arrive without remembering why.
lore.epic: Spilled from one enchanted bowl until the entire kitchen became a cornflake ocean. The dog sailed across it in a slipper.
lore.legendary: Crunchmor ate the silence of the first dawn and turned it into the sound of breakfast. Every morning the sun waits for the first crunch before rising.

names.legendary: Dryadrax, Keeper of the Endless Washing

lore.common: Opens its metal legs when you are carrying a basket. The hallway loses another square metre.
lore.uncommon: Has room for a hundred socks, but refuses the single pair you need tomorrow.
lore.rare: Moves its rails overnight and turns the living room into an obstacle course. The dog has earned a climbing certificate.
lore.epic: Expanded through the house like a steel forest and hung every curtain, coat and bedsheet in the kingdom. The royal family entered by crawling beneath the duvet covers.
lore.legendary: Dryadrax catches every wind that slips through a window and weaves it through wet laundry. Its legend ends when the final sock dries; scholars believe that will never happen.

names.legendary: Colesloth, Baron of the Shredded Realm

lore.common: Creeps off the edge of a barbecue plate and claims the tablecloth as new territory.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to be healthy because cabbage is involved. The mayonnaise knows better.
lore.rare: Can unravel an entire burger into neat little ribbons with one slither.
lore.epic: Became a living tide of creamy cabbage at the summer picnic. The hot dogs were evacuated on paper plates.
lore.legendary: Colesloth rules the lost kingdom beneath every buffet table, where carrots are shredded and cabbages whisper. Its crown is a single fork that nobody has ever managed to keep clean.

names.legendary: Lactellia, Queen of the Porcelain Seas

lore.common: Dribbles milk down its own spout rather than into the cup.
lore.uncommon: Adds precisely one drop too many, turning every strong tea into an apology.
lore.rare: Makes the coffee curdle whenever anyone lies about enjoying the office.
lore.epic: Filled the cafe with miniature milk clouds. The barista sold umbrellas next to the croissants.
lore.legendary: Stirred the first cream spiral that gave galaxies their shape. Her worshippers argue whether the universe was meant to be decaf.

names.legendary: Maharajah Madras, Lord of Seven Fires

lore.common: Looks perfectly mild until the third spoonful. Then it smiles.
lore.uncommon: Changes the menu's spice rating after everyone has ordered.
lore.rare: Speaks through clouds of fragrant steam and knows exactly who asked for extra hot to impress a date.
lore.epic: Turned a village curry competition into a volcanic weather event. The winner received a trophy and temporary eyebrows made of steam.
lore.legendary: Once challenged the fire gods to a tasting contest and served them seven secret spices. They still ask for the recipe, but none will admit needing yoghurt.

names.legendary: Aridrax, Thief of the Endless Monsoon

lore.common: Hums all night and produces enough water to make you suspicious.
lore.uncommon: Beeps at three in the morning to announce that its little bucket is full.
lore.rare: Dries out a room so thoroughly that the houseplants threaten to unionize.
lore.epic: Drank the humidity from an entire thunderstorm. The clouds demanded a refund and moved to another country.
lore.legendary: Once swallowed a hundred-year monsoon to rescue a flooded kingdom. Aridrax keeps the rain sealed in a tiny tank and shakes it whenever the king grows arrogant.

names.legendary: Archbishop Rackalot of the Last Plate

lore.common: Keeps one teaspoon hostage under the drip tray.
lore.uncommon: Rearranges wet plates by which ones are most likely to fall over.
lore.rare: Can balance a hundred dishes on one wire. Sneezes if anyone compliments it.
lore.epic: Built a tower of dinner plates through three floors of a restaurant. The final saucer contained a note saying WASH ME.
lore.legendary: Its steel ribs hold the dishes of every feast ever served. When the final banquet ends, Rackalot will ring the plates like a hundred silver bells.

names.legendary: Hydrion, Guardian of the Endless Spring

lore.common: Shoots water directly up the nose of anyone in a hurry.
lore.uncommon: Waits until somebody finishes drinking before spraying them in the ear.
lore.rare: Can tell who is genuinely thirsty. Gives queue-jumpers lukewarm water and a lecture.
lore.epic: Turned the school sports day into a miniature monsoon. The high jump was canceled after a frog cleared the bar.
lore.legendary: Hydrion guarded a spring at the center of a desert so vast that maps gave up. Travelers brought it stories as payment, and it kept the best tales flowing alongside the water.

names.legendary: Ovocrown, Guardian of the Golden Yolk

lore.common: Holds its egg upright and demands tiny toast soldiers salute.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles at the exact moment somebody taps the shell.
lore.rare: Can make every soft-boiled egg look like the face of a disapproving uncle.
lore.epic: Declared itself king of the breakfast table and ordered an army of toast soldiers into battle. The marmalade surrendered immediately.
lore.legendary: Ovocrown held the royal breakfast egg for twelve generations, until a mischievous prince replaced it with a dragon egg. The palace now serves toast soldiers to something considerably larger.

names.legendary: Sir Enamelot of the Last Ember

lore.common: Has one chipped rim and remembers exactly who dropped it.
lore.uncommon: Sings when the tea gets hot. The song is mostly complaints about burnt lips.
lore.rare: Turns any drink into smoky campfire tea, including orange juice and cough syrup.
lore.epic: Bailed out a sinking rowboat one mugful at a time while refusing to spill the captain's tea. The rescue crew arrived to find everyone having biscuits.
lore.legendary: Stood watch beside the last campfire of winter and brewed tea for the lost travellers who found its glow. At dawn, its chipped rim held a tiny sunrise.

names.legendary: Don Espresso, Lord of the Fourth Sip

lore.common: Is too small for a proper cup of tea and extremely offended by this.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a perfect brown moustache on anyone pretending to be sophisticated.
lore.rare: Can make a sleepy accountant finish twelve reports before the coffee cools. None of them add up.
lore.epic: Served a single espresso to the city's pigeons. They flew in formation, conquered the railway station and demanded a better timetable.
lore.legendary: The fourth sip of Don Espresso was outlawed by a kingdom that valued sleep. A rebel barista took it anyway and invented the twenty-five-hour day.

names.legendary: Madame Pedicure, Queen of the Deep

lore.common: Bubbles cheerfully around tired toes and has developed a concerning interest in socks.
lore.uncommon: Squirts its owner in the face the moment they finally relax. Calls this a surprise facial.
lore.rare: Knows exactly which foot is ticklish and will not discuss how it learned.
lore.epic: At the spa convention, its bubbles launched every slipper into the chandelier. They hung there like a very confused flock of bats.
lore.legendary: Once massaged the feet of a weary sea giant. He walked home across the ocean so lightly that not a single fish noticed.

names.legendary: Friedric, Lord of the Thousand Grains

lore.common: Hides peas and egg beneath its grains, then jumps out of the wok like a miniature surprise party.
lore.uncommon: Hides the egg bits at the bottom of the bowl and insists they are treasure.
lore.rare: Leaps from the wok in perfect formation. Each landing gives the cook a new hairstyle, made almost entirely of rice.
lore.epic: A single toss sent a cloud of rice over the town. For three days the pigeons believed winter had brought a generous new kind of snow.
lore.legendary: Friedric commands a thousand grains, each with its own tiny suit of armour. His army has never lost a battle; opponents keep stopping for seconds.

names.legendary: Spigotimus, Lord of the Hidden Spring

lore.common: Drips onto the path with the patience of a very small drummer. The snails keep time.
lore.uncommon: Drips so slowly that the garden snail is beginning to lose patience.
lore.rare: Turns itself on whenever the hose isn't attached. Pretends it was the wind.
lore.epic: Sent a geyser over the garden fence and filled the neighbour's empty paddling pool. The neighbour sent cake.
lore.legendary: Spigotimus guards a spring that flows uphill into the clouds. The village below gets gentle rain whenever someone remembers to turn the tap off.

names.legendary: Granolossus, the Honeybound Giant

lore.common: Hides the last raisin in a spoonful of oats and watches breakfast become an archaeological dig.
lore.uncommon: Clings between teeth until lunch and calls itself a nutritious souvenir.
lore.rare: Binds every oat and nut into an unbreakable honey fortress. The spoon has requested a tiny pickaxe.
lore.epic: Baked itself into a single colossal cluster that the breakfast club now uses as a meeting hall. The roof is exceptionally crunchy.
lore.legendary: A wandering giant scattered Granolossus across a barren valley. By sunrise the hills were golden oat clusters, and the villagers never went hungry again.

names.legendary: Admiral Jus, Lord of the Last Pour

lore.common: Dribbles brown rivers across the tablecloth and claims it is charting new waterways.
lore.uncommon: Sails past every plate except the one begging for gravy. Very strict about maritime schedules.
lore.rare: Summons tiny gravy waves that carry roast potatoes to whoever asks most politely.
lore.epic: A tidal wave of gravy washed through the royal feast. The peas launched a rescue fleet of Yorkshire puddings.
lore.legendary: Admiral Jus sailed across a sea of Sunday gravy in a porcelain boat. His crew still searches for the legendary roast potato that never becomes soggy.

names.legendary: Nimbusette, the Housebound Rainmaker

lore.common: Puffs a tiny cloud into the bedroom and acts offended when you call it a kettle.
lore.uncommon: Fogs up every window, so the cat has to make its own weather forecast.
lore.rare: Writes secret messages in hovering mist that can only be read before breakfast.
lore.epic: Turned one bedroom into a miniature rainforest overnight. A parrot moved into the wardrobe and refused to pay rent.
lore.legendary: Nimbusette shelters a lost raincloud inside its water tank. Each night it releases a gentle silver mist, and the flowers on the windowsill bloom even in deepest winter.

names.legendary: Little Dawn, the Sun-Catching Tumbler

lore.common: Collects all the orange pulp at the bottom like treasure nobody else appreciates.
lore.uncommon: Falls over whenever the cereal box looks at it the wrong way.
lore.rare: Catches a ray of sunlight and turns the juice inside into liquid gold until the last sip.
lore.epic: Spilled across the breakfast table in perfect orange letters spelling WAKE UP. The family obeyed, but the toast was ruined.
lore.legendary: Little Dawn holds the first sunbeam of every morning against its glass walls. On cloudy days, the village children gather around to see that sunrise has not forgotten them.

names.legendary: Lasagnara, Empress of a Thousand Layers

lore.common: Slides apart at the first forkful and pretends the serving spoon started it.
lore.uncommon: Keeps its middle hotter than the centre of a volcano even after everyone has finished eating.
lore.rare: Rearranges its pasta layers when nobody is looking, so the cheese ends up at the bottom.
lore.epic: Rose from the baking dish as a golden-walled tower of pasta. The dinner guests needed a ladder, and the crispy corner became the royal balcony.
lore.legendary: Lasagnara stacked the feasts of a hundred kingdoms into one endless dish. Each layer tastes of a different lost celebration, and the bottom is said to hold the recipe that taught the world to share.

names.legendary: Lady Luffa, Scourge of the Grime

lore.common: Hangs from the shower hook all day, plotting revenge against stubborn elbows.
lore.uncommon: Refuses to dry and leaves tiny puddles shaped like footprints.
lore.rare: Sprouts new vines whenever it hears someone say the bathroom needs cleaning.
lore.epic: Scrubbed the village rugby team so thoroughly that the referee could not tell the mud-coloured uniforms apart. The match ended as a water fight.
lore.legendary: Lady Luffa once washed the barnacles from a sunken palace. The palace rose sparkling from the sea, and the mermaids demanded their privacy back.

names.legendary: Macaronius, the Golden Cauldron

lore.common: Hides beneath its cheesy crust and waits to stretch a string onto your chin.
lore.uncommon: Hardens into a single solid slab the moment someone says 'leftovers'.
lore.rare: Summons rivers of molten cheddar through the little pasta tunnels. Even the broccoli surrenders.
lore.epic: Rose out of the oven as a golden cheese golem and marched across the buffet, collecting every breadcrumb as tribute.
lore.legendary: Macaronius guarded a cauldron that fed a thousand hungry travellers without running empty. The last scoop still waits, perfectly browned, for anyone who has lost their way.

names.legendary: Lady Stiletta, the Unbroken Toast

lore.common: Wobbles on its long stem every time someone sneezes near the table.
lore.uncommon: Keeps one olive suspended with the haughty confidence of a museum curator.
lore.rare: Changes any drink into an impossible shade of blue, making the water waiter question everything.
lore.epic: Held the royal banquet's final toast while every other glass shattered to a mysterious chorus. It refused to spill a drop.
lore.legendary: Lady Stiletta survived the fall of seven glittering ballrooms without so much as a chip. At every new palace, a single crystal chime announces her arrival before the guests do.

names.legendary: Grandmother Graduella, the Rain Counter

lore.common: Drips down its spout after every pour, even when filled with absolutely nothing.
lore.uncommon: Has markings for three different units and takes great delight in confusing everyone.
lore.rare: Measures bad moods in millilitres. Grandad's reading once overflowed the scale.
lore.epic: Counted every drop of water in the flooded kitchen while the rest of the family bailed. It even recorded the two goldfish.
lore.legendary: Grandmother Graduella once counted every raindrop of the monsoon and carried the number to the sky. Now the clouds consult her markings before they open.

names.legendary: Calcia, the Goblet of Gentle Strength

lore.common: Gives every drinker a white moustache that disappears just before anyone can photograph it.
lore.uncommon: Forgets to return to the fridge after bedtime and becomes deeply unpopular by morning.
lore.rare: Makes its drinker feel strong enough to carry all the shopping bags at once. The bags disagree.
lore.epic: Poured a white wave over the breakfast table and crowned every family member with a magnificent milk moustache.
lore.legendary: Calcia once shared a cup with a weary giant unable to lift his fallen bridge. By sunrise he had raised it, and the villagers built a glass monument to their kindness.

names.legendary: Oatfather, Hearth of the Winter Valley

lore.common: Bubbles from the breakfast pot and sticks to the spoon like an affectionate swamp creature.
lore.uncommon: Grows twice its size when nobody is looking. The little bowl is starting to worry.
lore.rare: Sets so firmly that the builders borrow a leftover bowl to patch garden walls.
lore.epic: Overflowed the scout camp cauldron and sent a slow-moving wave of porridge through the tents. Everyone woke up with breakfast already in their boots.
lore.legendary: Oatfather fed a frozen valley from one warm bowl of oats that never emptied. Even the snowmen gathered round its hearth, watching their own frost turn to steam.

names.legendary: Dona Saffronia of the Hundred Tables

lore.common: Hides one stubborn piece of rice at the bottom of the pan and fights to keep it.
lore.uncommon: Arranges its prawns around the top like nobles demanding the best seat.
lore.rare: Forms a perfect crisp golden crust beneath its rice. The cook guards it like a treasure map.
lore.epic: Summoned a miniature fleet of seafood across the giant festival pan. The prawns took command and the mussels declared independence.
lore.legendary: Dona Saffronia fed a starving coastal town from one pot of saffron rice. Every time another guest sat down, a new golden portion appeared, until the harbour smelled of dinner for a week.

names.legendary: Phoenara, Keeper of the First Broth

lore.common: Splashes broth on every shirt, then offers an apologetic noodle.
lore.uncommon: Hides behind a mountain of herbs and emerges smelling like an entire market garden.
lore.rare: Sends fragrant steam into the noses of homesick travellers, leading them to the nearest welcoming table.
lore.epic: Unleashed a tornado of noodles inside a packed restaurant. Every diner emerged wearing a steaming scarf and asking for extra lime.
lore.legendary: Phoenara simmered a single bowl through a century of wandering, gathering a herb from every land. Its broth lets strangers share the memory of a home-cooked meal.

names.legendary: Gurgulon, Breaker of the Great Blockage

lore.common: Waits beside the toilet looking a little too excited about emergencies.
lore.uncommon: Clings to the bathroom wall after one enthusiastic thump and refuses to come down.
lore.rare: Sucks a blockage through three turns of pipe without moving the sink an inch.
lore.epic: Unblocked the city sewers with one mighty pull, causing every fountain in town to erupt at once. The ducks considered it a national holiday.
lore.legendary: Gurgulon pulled the ancient plug from the bottom of the ocean and swapped the tides for one afternoon. The crabs were late to work and the mermaids filed a complaint.

names.legendary: Old Oatilda of the Three Bowls

lore.common: Bubbles ominously in the saucepan, then sticks the moment the cook turns away.
lore.uncommon: Is always too hot, too cold or exactly the wrong flavour for the hungriest child.
lore.rare: Sets so solid that the spoon stands upright like a tiny monument to bad cooking.
lore.epic: Escaped its pot during the village breakfast and rolled down the street like a warm oat avalanche. Every house received free porridge through the letterbox.
lore.legendary: Old Oatilda served three wandering bears a breakfast that was finally just right. Their descendants still come to her cottage every winter, bringing honey and unusually small chairs.

names.legendary: Ramenzoku, Soul of the Endless Broth

lore.common: Flings one noodle onto the chin of anybody eating too confidently.
lore.uncommon: Hides the soft-boiled egg under the noodles until every other topping is gone.
lore.rare: Sends tendrils of noodles across the table to steal chopsticks from rival bowls.
lore.epic: Uncoiled its noodles through every street of the noodle festival. The entire town joined a single spectacular slurp.
lore.legendary: Ramenzoku's broth refills whenever a traveller is hungry. It once fed a thousand warriors; the final noodle was so long that they used it to pull their carts home.

names.legendary: Venthara, Empress of the Lost Aromas

lore.common: Hums louder than the frying pan and still lets the toast smell escape.
lore.uncommon: Drinks all the kitchen steam but coughs out one drop of greasy water onto the chef's hat.
lore.rare: Sucks a cookbook off the counter and returns it with every recipe mysteriously improved.
lore.epic: Inhaled the smells of every restaurant on the street and released them all at once. Nobody could tell whether to order sushi or roast potatoes.
lore.legendary: Venthara gathered the aromas of every feast held in a vanished city. Once each century she releases one breath, and hungry travellers find its hidden ruins.

names.legendary: Bowlorin, Vessel of Endless Hospitality

lore.common: Rings like a bell whenever its owner wants another serving.
lore.uncommon: Hides one grain of rice on the rim where it sticks to an unsuspecting chin.
lore.rare: Keeps a meal warm through a long winter evening and always saves a portion for the last guest.
lore.epic: Sent a towering avalanche of fluffy rice across the banquet floor. The guests used chopsticks as ski poles.
lore.legendary: Bowlorin served rice to every guest at a thousand-day wedding, never running empty. The guests left; the rice grains still keep arriving dressed in formalwear.

names.legendary: Risottara, Mistress of the Endless Stir

lore.common: Needs another splash of stock precisely when the cook thinks dinner is ready.
lore.uncommon: Clings to the wooden spoon and refuses to let the chef take a break.
lore.rare: Absorbs an entire jug of broth without getting soggy, then demands more parmesan.
lore.epic: Swallowed a river of stock during the royal feast and turned into a golden mountain of rice. The guests climbed it with spoons.
lore.legendary: Risottara stirred the king's supper for a hundred years without spilling a grain. The king died; the cook retired; the rice finally declared itself al dente.

names.legendary: Treadelora, the Living Loomhall

lore.common: Kicks its foot pedal whenever someone sits down to tie a shoe.
lore.uncommon: Hides a spool of red thread in the treadle mechanism so the whole room thinks it has a heartbeat.
lore.rare: Unfolds hidden wooden supports to turn a cramped corner into a grand dressmaker's workshop.
lore.epic: Converted the village hall into a whirring garment factory during the costume emergency. Everyone woke wearing velvet capes, even the mayor's bicycle.
lore.legendary: Treadelora was carved from a tree that remembered every garment ever made beneath its branches. Set a machine upon her and she weaves a cloak from those memories, with pockets for lost time.

names.legendary: Elsbeth, Cabinet of Dreams

lore.common: Collects loose pins under its table leg and rattles whenever anyone tries to vacuum.
lore.uncommon: Keeps the best cloth scraps in a secret drawer marked NOTHING IMPORTANT.
lore.rare: Unfolds its leaves into a workspace that always has room for the next ambitious pattern.
lore.epic: Awoke at midnight and assembled an army of cloth mannequins wearing unfinished ball gowns. They marched down the high street demanding fittings.
lore.legendary: Elsbeth keeps every abandoned dress pattern folded beneath her oak top. On midsummer nights they rise as magnificent gowns to attend the ball their makers never reached.

names.legendary: Thimbriel, Keeper of the Last Drop

lore.common: Holds a single raisin and insists it is serving an elaborate banquet.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to be an eggcup at breakfast and scares the boiled egg.
lore.rare: Compresses an entire jug of juice into one impossible sip. The drinker burps a rainbow.
lore.epic: Trapped a thunderstorm in its thick glass base. Every toast at the party came with lightning and a tiny clap of thunder.
lore.legendary: Thimbriel carries the final drop of a vanished sea inside a glass no taller than a thumb. One sip reveals the sound of its waves, but never leaves anybody thirsty.

names.legendary: Aquavella, the Rain That Waited for You

lore.common: Starts warm, switches to ice water and enjoys the dramatic squeal.
lore.uncommon: Changes temperature whenever the neighbour runs a tap. It insists this is a coincidence.
lore.rare: Turns ordinary shower water into tiny coloured rainbows that follow its bather through the house.
lore.epic: Replaced every shower in a seaside hotel with miniature tropical rainstorms. The guests reported an excellent holiday and a flock of parrots.
lore.legendary: Aquavella caught the first warm rain to fall after a hundred-year drought and hid it in her silver pipes. Her water never runs cold for anyone returning from a long journey.

names.legendary: Torrento, the Thousand-Drop Dragon

lore.common: Aims exactly one jet at the bathroom ceiling no matter how carefully it is adjusted.
lore.uncommon: Clogs half its nozzles and transforms a gentle shower into an aggressive squirt gun.
lore.rare: Sends perfectly warm jets around the whole room to wash a muddy dog without touching the tiles.
lore.epic: Sprayed a thousand spiralling jets that scrubbed the entire water park in minutes. The lifeguards emerged looking suspiciously polished.
lore.legendary: Torrento lives in a silver showerhead with a thousand hidden streams. When he woke during the great fire, his rain fell on every roof but left the birthday cakes perfectly dry.

names.legendary: Mistress Mugwort of the Winter Hearth

lore.common: Looks like an ordinary tea mug until you find a rogue noodle in the bottom.
lore.uncommon: Keeps your hands warm while whispering extremely rude things about cold sandwiches.
lore.rare: Changes the soup's flavour to match whoever needs cheering up, though it thinks everyone needs more garlic.
lore.epic: Filled the rush-hour bus with thick, fragrant soup steam. By the final stop all the windows had become menus and nobody wanted to get off.
lore.legendary: When the longest winter forgot to end, Mugwort served a single steaming cup beneath the village oak. Spring came to ask for seconds.

names.legendary: Absorbia, Bearer of the Borrowed Sea

lore.common: Lives by the sink and takes pride in turning yellow into a mysterious shade of grey.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to be dry until somebody squeezes it and gets a cold splash up the sleeve.
lore.rare: Absorbs the colours of anything it touches, leaving a black-and-white world behind until it sneezes them back.
lore.epic: Swelled into a gigantic sponge castle during the flood and rescued an entire town by drinking up the river.
lore.legendary: Absorbia carries a sea inside its countless tiny chambers. When it weeps, little coral reefs appear in the footprints it leaves behind.

names.legendary: Count Cuberose, Lord of Sugar

lore.common: Collects sugar cubes and refuses to return them without a tiny bow.
lore.uncommon: Has imprisoned three pairs of miniature tongs for crimes against afternoon tea.
lore.rare: Makes every cup on the table sweet before the spoon even reaches it. The soup is furious.
lore.epic: Summoned a glittering avalanche of sugar lumps during a palace banquet and buried the royal dentist.
lore.legendary: Count Cuberose guards the last sugar crystal from a winter when nothing could grow. It grants sweetness only to those who share their tea.

names.legendary: Sir Tankwyn, the Unbroken Toast

lore.common: Clanks on the table so hard the peas jump into formation.
lore.uncommon: Grows a magnificent moustache of foam around anyone who takes a sip.
lore.rare: Makes every drinker speak in medieval proclamations, including when ordering a glass of water.
lore.epic: Raised a toast so thunderous that every mug in the banquet hall began marching across the tables.
lore.legendary: Sir Tankwyn held the last warm drink during a siege that outlasted seven winters. Each time he lifted his pewter cup, the defenders remembered why they had stayed.

names.legendary: Madame Rattle, Oracle of the Last Sip

lore.common: Rattles its saucer like an impatient little tambourine during polite visits.
lore.uncommon: Collects drips and calls them a second, much smaller cup of tea.
lore.rare: Reads fortunes in leftover leaves, mostly involving biscuits and awkward relatives.
lore.epic: Challenged every piece of fine china to a duel and won without spilling one drop. The butter dish was disqualified for cheating.
lore.legendary: Madame Rattle foretold the fate of seven dynasties in one cup of tea. Her final prophecy was simply more cake, and it was the first one nobody questioned.

names.legendary: Chinavella, Hostess of the Century Feast

lore.common: Has one odd cup and always offers it to the person in charge.
lore.uncommon: Makes the chipped saucer rattle whenever somebody uses the wrong fork.
lore.rare: Lays itself out before guests arrive, including an extra place for an unexpected friend.
lore.epic: Hosted a tea party for every creature in the enchanted garden; the hedgehogs demanded cushions and the dragons brought their own sugar.
lore.legendary: Chinavella invited the feuding moon and sun to a table set for two. After a thousand cups they agreed to take turns, and the first peaceful dawn began.

names.legendary: Captain Bristlebarnacle of the Deep Bowl

lore.common: Waits beside the toilet in a damp little bucket, plotting its next splash.
lore.uncommon: Dresses in a crown of soap bubbles after every heroic scrub.
lore.rare: Scrubs the porcelain so fiercely that the toilet begins humming sea shanties. The sink has joined the chorus.
lore.epic: Led an army of bristles through the hotel plumbing and polished every bathroom until the mirrors started saluting.
lore.legendary: Captain Bristlebarnacle sailed down the palace's ancient pipes to defeat the legendary Grime of Seven Cisterns. He returned triumphant and requested a fresh bucket.

names.legendary: Viajara, the Cup That Followed the Stars

lore.common: Drips coffee down your coat in exactly the shape of the company logo.
lore.uncommon: Loses its lid in the car and rolls under the driver's seat, laughing.
lore.rare: Keeps a drink hot through a whole workday, then cools it instantly when the owner finally remembers it.
lore.epic: Survived a hundred bumps in a runaway bus without spilling a drop, then launched a geyser of coffee at the ticket inspector.
lore.legendary: Viajara carried the first explorer's coffee through the starless northern night, holding warmth against the impossible cold. The trail of her gentle steam still guides lost travellers towards shelter.

names.legendary: Fontanella, Choreographer of Rivers

lore.common: Sprays the one person who is only trying to walk past.
lore.uncommon: Asks every tossed penny to make a wish on its behalf.
lore.rare: Shapes its water into little animals whenever children gather nearby.
lore.epic: Erupted in a spectacular fountain ballet during the summer festival. The bronze statue stepped off its pedestal for an encore.
lore.legendary: Once persuaded seven rivers to dance in the town square without spilling a drop. When the music ended, each river flowed home remembering a new song.

names.legendary: Pumpellus, the River Awakener

lore.common: Squeaks ten times before offering a single drop.
lore.uncommon: Waits until the bucket has been put away to start working.
lore.rare: Pulls up lost treasures from wells, usually things nobody remembers losing.
lore.epic: Pumped the village fountain so enthusiastically that water shot over the church roof and landed in the brass band's instruments. They finished the concert bubbling.
lore.legendary: Once drew a buried river out of the dry earth for a wandering caravan. The stream has followed their descendants ever since, always arriving before thirst.

names.legendary: Calyxa, the Unspilled Oracle

lore.common: Rocks in slow circles until everyone at the table gets seasick watching.
lore.uncommon: Has no stem and calls tall glasses show-offs.
lore.rare: Rolls toward the thirstiest guest, then stops precisely before the table edge as if bowing.
lore.epic: Dame Spinsteady crossed a ballroom on a runaway serving trolley without losing one drop. The chandelier demanded lessons in balance.
lore.legendary: Calyxa survived a thousand tumbles without spilling her final drop. In that drop lies the reflection of every place she has visited, including a city that has not yet been built.
